comment: pickup.c out_container() -> invent.c addinv() -> merged(): the Valkyrie's starting food ration, whose curse status she knows, is taken out of a sack and merges with a wished ration whose status she does not, so the comparison prints "You learn more about your items by comparing them."  A debug Valkyrie wishes for a sack, stashes the ration, wishes for another ration, then takes the first back out.
